latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Editing App.

- Edit and export MP4 clips up to 500MB with automated AI editing—no manual controls needed.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; outputs polished 1080p MP4 files.
- Simple prompts trigger edits like pause trimming, adding background music, and exporting.
- On first use, automatically connects to a cloud backend for GPU-powered video processing.
- Built-in session and token management, with 100 free credits valid for 7 days per account.
- Handles uploads, exports, credit checks, and live status/polling with clear user feedback.
